basis: Microcap with a record Q4: revenue +48.9%, net income $1.5m vs a prior-year loss, adj. EBITDA margin 20.3% vs 6.1%. It also discloses a ~$910k IEEPA duty refund that will land in FY27 and a store count up from ~1,800 to ~6,000. The text gives no consensus, so this is sized on the year-over-year step-up; part of the margin came from duty refunds.
